key_points: Meta's Muse AI agent sparked a 6% sell‑off in SCHW, dragging the stock lower today
Market narrative frames AI competition as a risk to brokerage economics, despite higher rates benefiting net interest income
No earnings or guidance change; the move appears reactionary rather than fundamentals‑driven
Schwab's ETF arm saw ~$15B outflows, adding pressure on assets under management
Broad brokerage sector weakness (AT&T, travel, insurers) reinforces short‑term bearish bias
